_meta.purpose: The OLLVM / d810-ng simplification pass catalog. The re-vtil simplify_lifted_il tool takes a pass list and applies it to a lifted IL tree. Vendor-neutral: pass names are the public d810-ng / VTIL pass enum values, no product names.

pass_categories.dead_store_elimination: Remove stores to a memory location that is overwritten before any read.
pass_categories.branch_folding: Fold branches whose condition is provably constant after a previous pass.
pass_categories.mem_dependency: Reorder memory accesses to expose dataflow that the prior passes missed.
pass_categories.mba_fold: Replace mixed boolean-arithmetic identities with the simpler form. Sources the re-mba-deobfuscate skill's mba_patterns.identities table from drm-indicators.yaml.
pass_categories.constant_folding: Fold arithmetic on constants into a single constant.
pass_categories.opaque_predicate_eval: Evaluate predicates whose truth is provable from prior dataflow (e.g. `x*x >= 0` for signed x).
pass_categories.string_decrypt: Recognize the `ldstr -> call Get<name>(); ret` pattern in .NET IL and replace with the literal string. (Pairs with re-dotnet's run_il_simplification tool.)
pass_categories.control_flow_unflatten: Unflatten switch-dispatcher state machines. The d810-ng canonical pass.

source_credits: https://github.com/can1357/NoVmp (VM-pack deobfuscation; some passes ported from here)

passes.name: dead_store_elimination
passes.description: Remove stores to a memory location that is overwritten before any read.

passes.name: branch_folding
passes.description: Fold branches whose condition is provably constant after a previous pass.
triggers: After constant_folding has simplified the branch condition.

passes.name: mem_dependency
passes.description: Reorder memory accesses to expose dataflow that the prior passes missed.

passes.name: mba_fold
passes.description: Replace mixed boolean-arithmetic identities with the simpler form.
triggers: When the re-mba-deobfuscate skill's identities table has fired on the same function.

passes.name: constant_folding
passes.description: Fold arithmetic on constants into a single constant.

passes.name: opaque_predicate_eval
passes.description: Evaluate predicates whose truth is provable from prior dataflow.
triggers: When the predicate references only known-constant operands (e.g. x*x, (x | 1)).

passes.name: string_decrypt
passes.description: Recognize the ldstr -> call Get<name>(); ret pattern and replace with the literal string.
triggers: Only applies to .NET IL lifted to VTIL.

passes.name: control_flow_unflatten
triggers: When a switch-dispatcher pattern is detected (a single basic block with high in-degree + a state-variable update + a switch on the state).
